scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/react && npm run build -w packages/solid --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.preversion: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && git add packages/*/package.json package-lock.json
